scope: Additive active-week DAL-PHI preparation after the official final. The final score, frozen pre-kickoff ratings/H4, corrected complete paired inactive and reserve inventories, game-day elevations, QB/specialist candidate inventories, retained governed personnel cases and every injury event printed by the official team recap are preserved under Week 7. The pair remains BLOCKED because the official final gamebook is not yet exposed and therefore complete starters/substitutes/DNP, QB/specialist participation and the full printed injury sequence cannot be certified. No learning, rating, fair, customer number or bet is produced.

sources.finding: NFL final-score service records Dallas 38, Philadelphia 21, FINAL.

Complete final active-roster inactive lists: DAL Emari Demercado, KaVontae Turpin, Drew Shelton, Tyrus Wheat and Dee Winters; PHI Cole Payton (emergency third quarterback), DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks, Jake Majors, Nolan Smith Jr. and Michael Carter II.

Complete current Dallas active, Reserve/Designated to Return and Reserve/Injured inventories, correcting Marist Liufau and P.J. Locke to reserve/DTR rather than active-roster inactives and adding Kelvin Gilliam and DJ Rogers to the reserve inventory.
Complete current Philadelphia active, Reserve/Injured and Reserve/Non-Football Injury inventories, including Tucker Large on Reserve/NFI.
Grant Calcaterra, Landon Dickerson and Eli Stowers activated; Keyshawn James-Newby and Elijah Mitchell elevated; Jakorian Bennett remained on Reserve/Injured.

Official play-by-play recap confirms the 38-21 final, QB and specialist activity visible in the recap, and printed injury events for Britain Covey, Quinyon Mitchell and Dameon Pierce. It is not a substitute for the complete final gamebook participation and injury tables.
The Week 7 DAL-PHI row shows the Game Book control without a downloadable link at capture time.

blockers.finding: The official final inactive and complete reserve sources add Emari Demercado, Tyrus Wheat, Kelvin Gilliam, DJ Rogers, Jake Majors and Tucker Large beyond the prior numerical candidate set. They are retained explicitly as UNRESOLVED cases.
blockers.footballImpact: Their possible running-back, edge, line, tight-end, safety and special-teams roles could change the paired injury interval if they had established healthy duty.
blockers.nextAction: Apply the approved value hierarchy and source-confirmed role assessment after complete participation is bound; use a supported no-established-baseline-role ruling when eligible, never a fabricated zero.

blockers.footballImpact: Arbitrary exposure intervals could materially distort Philadelphia return, secondary and running-back loss.
blockers.nextAction: Use the complete official gamebook injury sequence when available; retain unknown boundaries rather than manufacturing duration.
